nodes.label: Synthwave Sunset (Option 01)
nodes.author: Abhilash Makode
nodes.rationale: Retro 80s synthwave — warm, intense, electric. Hot pink and purple with gold highlights. Colors: #ff2d78, #b44cff, #ff6b35, #ffd700, bg #0a0015.

nodes.label: Matrix Green (Option 02)
nodes.author: Abhilash Makode
nodes.rationale: Minimal hacker-aesthetic — monochromatic green with teal accents. Clean, sharp, cyberpunk. Colors: #00ff41, #00b4d8, #00cc88, #88ff00, bg #000a00.

nodes.label: Ocean Depths (Option 03)
nodes.author: Abhilash Makode
nodes.rationale: Cool, professional, calming blue-teal tones. Corporate-friendly but modern. Colors: #00e5ff, #2979ff, #536dfe, #1de9b6, bg #001220.

nodes.label: Midnight Ember (Option 04)
nodes.author: Abhilash Makode
nodes.rationale: Dark academia meets fire — moody, elegant, warm. Amber and rust with deep purple. Colors: #ffb300, #ff5252, #7c4dff, #ff6d00, bg #0d0d12. This is the currently selected palette.

nodes.label: Hero + Grid Layout
nodes.author: Abhilash Makode
nodes.rationale: One big hero skill displayed prominently, with sub-skills in an icon grid below. Option #1.

nodes.label: Big Card + Badge Grid Layout
nodes.author: Abhilash Makode
nodes.rationale: Main skill as a large horizontal card with sub-skills as inline icon badges. Option #2.

nodes.label: Category Row Stripes Layout
nodes.author: Abhilash Makode
nodes.rationale: Each category is a horizontal stripe: icon + title + inline skill badges. Option #3.

nodes.label: Hub & Spoke Layout
nodes.author: Abhilash Makode
nodes.rationale: Main skill as a central circle with sub-skills arranged around it. Option #4.

nodes.label: Sectioned Groups (Current) Layout
nodes.author: Abhilash Makode
nodes.rationale: All categories stacked vertically, each with a section header and inline icon badges. Currently used layout. Option #5.

nodes.label: Tree View Layout
nodes.author: Abhilash Makode
nodes.rationale: Hierarchical tree with main skills as branches and sub-skills as leaves. Option #6.

nodes.label: Git Branch Rule: Use opencode
nodes.rationale: All commits MUST be made to the opencode branch. Never commit to master or main.

nodes.label: Tech Stack Reference
nodes.rationale: React 19 + TypeScript 5.9 + Vite 8 (beta) + Framer Motion + Lucide React + ESLint 9.

nodes.label: Design Preferences
nodes.rationale: Neon multicolor theme (cyan, purple, pink, green, blue). Smooth animations, glass-morphism cards, marquee/carousels.

nodes.label: Design System (Midnight Ember)
nodes.rationale: CSS variables: --neon-cyan (#ffb300), --neon-purple (#7c4dff), --neon-pink (#ff5252), --neon-green (#ff6d00). Fonts: Inter (body), Outfit (headings), JetBrains Mono (code). Glass cards with backdrop-filter blur.

nodes.label: Data Layer
nodes.rationale: All content is static TypeScript arrays/objects in src/data/. No API calls. 7 data files with 100+ skills, 6 projects, 4 jobs, 4 certs, 9 roles, 35 tech names.

nodes.label: 404 Page Gradient Design
nodes.rationale: Dark background #0d0d12 with radial gradients using amber, purple, and rust tones matching Midnight Ember palette. Gradient text 404 with Inter/Outfit/JetBrains Mono fonts.

nodes.label: Midnight Ember Palette (Chosen)
nodes.rationale: The selected color scheme for the portfolio. Amber (#ffb300) primary, purple (#7c4dff) secondary, pink/rust (#ff5252) tertiary, orange (#ff6d00) indicator.

nodes.label: Neon Multicolor Theme
nodes.rationale: Cyan, purple, pink, green, blue neon accents on dark background. Glass-morphism cards with backdrop-filter blur.
